name: dde-cycle-oracle
model: par mu=0.3, tau=1.5707963267948966; x' = -delay(x,tau) + mu*x*(1 - x^2 - delay(x,tau)^2)
exact_orbit: x(t) = sin t with period 2 pi, for every mu and for tau = pi/2 + 2 pi K with K = 0, 1, 2, ...
orbit_check: x(t - tau) = -cos t for these tau, so the right side is cos t = x'(t)

multipliers.method: RK4 on the variational equation v' = -v(t - tau) + mu*((1 - 3 x^2 - x_tau^2) v - 2 x x_tau v(t - tau)) along x = sin t, history of the monodromy matrix on [-tau, 0] given by Hermite cubics with C1 data, eigenvalues of the matrix at t = 2 pi. Step h = (pi/2)/N, so tau is a whole number of steps. N = 100 and N = 200 agree to about 5e-10. The values below are N = 200. The trivial multiplier 1 is omitted. This is a numerical oracle with about 9 digits, not a closed form. Conjugates are not listed twice.
